query: Our security token on Stellar needs us to approve every transfer, not just the trustline. How do wallets get our sign-off?
expected_behavior: Names SEP-0008 (Regulated Assets) and its approval server, not only AUTH_REQUIRED trustline authorization
Sets both AUTH_REQUIRED and AUTH_REVOCABLE on the issuer
Publishes `regulated = true`, `approval_server` and `approval_criteria` in the asset's stellar.toml `[[CURRENCIES]]` entry
Has the wallet POST the user-signed transaction as `tx` and handle success, revised, pending, action_required and rejected
Tells the wallet to inspect a revised transaction for added operations sourced from the user's account before re-signing
Does not route a classic-asset approval flow to SEP-0057 (T-REX), which covers contract tokens
